mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a strict completed four-hour BTC close crossover of the canonical Variable Index Dynamic Average marks a trend change while CMO magnitude causally adapts the EMA smoothing speed; follow the new side for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when completed close-minus-VIDYA crosses strictly from negative to positive; short on the strict reverse crossover
mechanism.why_distinct: VIDYA recursively scales a fixed EMA factor by the absolute canonical CMO, unlike KAMA path-efficiency smoothing, FRAMA fractal-dimension smoothing, ALMA fixed Gaussian weighting, or fixed-speed moving averages. It uses no volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour volatility-adaptive state crossovers are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.cmo: over nine completed close changes, (sum positive changes minus absolute sum negative changes) divided by their sum, strict positive denominator
features.vidya: causal recursive prior VIDYA plus smoothing_factor*(completed close-prior VIDYA), initialized at the first source-valid completed close with nine-change history and reset across source gaps
features.crossover: current completed close-minus-VIDYA strict nonzero sign differs from immediately prior finite nonzero sign
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: MetaQuotes-documented VIDYA(9,12) price crossover under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no CMO/EMA period, initialization, crossover, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Tushar Chande Variable Index Dynamic Average as documented by MetaQuotes
external_basis.fixed_definition: CMO period 9 and EMA period 12 on close; F=2/(12+1); VIDYA(i)=Price(i)*F*abs(CMO(i))+VIDYA(i-1)*(1-F*abs(CMO(i)))
external_basis.selection_use: MetaQuotes-published 9/12 parameters, formula, and price-versus-VIDYA one-crossover interpretation only; no incidence or outcomes
